episodes.title: Teenager Soup and a Little Ball of Fib
episodes.description: Sheldon fakes being sick to avoid a swim test at school. Also, Dr. Sturgis spies on Meemaw's new boyfriend.

episodes.title: A Live Chicken, a Fried Chicken and Holy Matrimony
episodes.description: George Sr. and Meemaw struggle to manage the Cooper household while Mary plans Pastor Jeff's wedding.

episodes.title: Body Glitter and a Mall Safety Kit
episodes.description: Sheldon learns to listen when an emotional Paige struggles with her parents' divorce. Also, George Sr. is furious when Georgie tries to buy his way out of chores.

episodes.title: Contracts, Rules and a Little Bit of Pig Brains
episodes.description: George Sr. and Georgie go camping with Meemaw's new boyfriend, Dale, but things get complicated when her ex-boyfriend, Dr. Sturgis, tags along. Also, Sheldon and Missy invent a super-game.

episodes.title: A Slump, a Cross and Roadside Gravel
episodes.description: Sheldon and Georgie mine for platinum in roadside gravel. Also, Mary is concerned when Missy misuses religion to help with a batting slump.

episodes.title: A Boyfriend's Ex-Wife and a Good Luck Head Rub
episodes.description: Meemaw meets Dale's ex-wife, June. Also, Sheldon is forced to work on a group project with reluctant college students.

episodes.title: Pasadena
episodes.description: Sheldon visits CalTech for the very first time. Also, Georgie is furious when Mary listens in on a phone call with his girlfriend, and Meemaw tries to cheer up a jealous Missy.

episodes.title: An Academic Crime and a More Romantic Taco Bell
episodes.description: Dr. Sturgis is furious when Sheldon accuses him of plagiarism. Also, Mary sets out to find a "girl trophy" for Missy's end-of-season baseball ceremony, and Georgie has an awkward run-in with Veronica while on a date with his new girlfriend, Jana.

episodes.title: A Couple Bruised Ribs and a Cereal Box Ghost Detector
episodes.description: When George Sr. accidentally lands the school librarian, Ms. Hutchins, in the hospital, the Cooper family must nurse her back to health. Also, Meemaw gives Georgie relationship advice.

episodes.title: A House for Sale and Serious Woman Stuff
episodes.description: When Sheldon learns the house next door is for sale, he takes it upon himself to find the perfect neighbors. Also, Missy is torn when she's forced to pitch against her boyfriend at the baseball game.

episodes.title: A Baby Tooth and the Egyptian God of Knowledge
episodes.description: Sheldon has a scientific breakthrough at the dentist's office. Also, Dale and Meemaw go to the casino, and Georgie makes a big mistake when Dale leaves him in charge of the store.

episodes.title: A Secret Letter and a Lowly Disc of Processed Meat
episodes.description: Sheldon discovers that Mary's been keeping a secret about his future. Also, Meemaw is furious when she learns Dale fired Georgie.

episodes.title: Graduation
episodes.description: After graduating high school, Sheldon has a breakdown when he realizes he may not be ready for college. Also, Dale tries to make amends with Meemaw.

episodes.title: A Docent, a Little Lady and a Bouncer Named Dalton
episodes.description: Sheldon gets a summer job at the local train museum. Also, George and Missy bond when Missy embarks on a new stage of womanhood, and Georgie discovers Mary's guilty pleasure.

episodes.title: Training Wheels and an Unleashed Chicken
episodes.description: With college in sight, Sheldon is determined to ride his bike without training wheels. Also, Mary and George Sr. argue over parenting styles.

episodes.title: Bible Camp and a Chariot of Love
episodes.description: Sheldon finds himself in a fierce competition with Paige when their mothers force them to attend Vacation Bible School. George is furious after Georgie makes a questionable purchase.

episodes.title: A Musty Crypt and a Stick to Pee On
episodes.description: Dale and Meemaw work out relationship issues while playing Dungeons and Dragons with Sheldon and Missy. Also, Mary and George take a trip with Coach Wilkins and his wife, and Georgie freaks out when his girlfriend thinks she's pregnant.

episodes.title: Freshman Orientation and the Inventor of the Zipper
episodes.description: College orientation does not go as Sheldon planned. Also, Mary is invited to a party when she's mistaken for a university student, and George Sr. helps Pastor Jeff set up a children's nursery.

episodes.title: A Philosophy Class and Worms That Can Chase You
episodes.description: Sheldon's first day of college is derailed by his new philosophy teacher, Professor Ericson. Also, Mary and Brenda live vicariously through Missy's first day of middle school.

episodes.title: An Existential Crisis and a Bear That Makes Bubbles
episodes.description: Meemaw takes matters into her own hands when Sheldon's philosophy teacher, Professor Ericson, sends him into a tailspin. Also, George Sr. learns Georgie has been cutting class.

episodes.title: Crappy Frozen Ice Cream and an Organ Grinder's Monkey
episodes.description: Sheldon and George Sr. dine with President Hagemeyer and a university benefactor. Also, Georgie gives Missy some brotherly advice when Mary won't let her go to the school dance, and Dale and June convince Meemaw to attend their son's wedding.

episodes.title: Cowboy Aerobics and 473 Grease-Free Bolts
episodes.description: Sheldon campaigns to become Dr. Linkletter's lab assistant. Also, Georgie enlists the help of Mr. Lundy, the drama teacher, for a surprising business venture.

episodes.title: A Pager, a Club and a Cranky Bag of Wrinkles
episodes.description: Dr. Linkletter pushes Sheldon to make friends with his fellow students at college. Also, Georgie gets a pager.

episodes.title: A Box of Treasure and the Meemaw of Science
episodes.description: Sheldon, Dr. Linkletter and Meemaw team up on a science experiment. Also, Mary is jealous that Pastor Jeff and Brenda are spending time together, and Georgie has a new side hustle.

episodes.title: The Geezer Bus and a New Model for Education
episodes.description: Sheldon refuses to ride in a car after getting into an accident with Meemaw. Also, Missy uses their trauma to her advantage at school and Meemaw is forced to take the church shuttle while her car is in the shop.

episodes.title: Mitch's Son and the Unconditional Approval of a Government Agency
episodes.description: When the IRS accuses Sheldon of making a mistake, he'll stop at nothing to prove them wrong. Also, Dale is forced to get a colonoscopy and tries to convince Meemaw to join him.

episodes.title: A Virus, Heartbreak and a World of Possibilities
episodes.description: Sheldon is caught in a moral dilemma when offered a bootleg copy of a computer game he can't afford. Also, Mary and Meemaw take Brenda out for girls' night while George Sr. and the guys watch Billy, and Missy asks Georgie to take her and Marcus on a secret date.

episodes.title: A Second Prodigy and the Hottest Tips for Pouty Lips
episodes.description: Sheldon finds himself at odds with Paige once again when she considers enrolling at East Texas Tech. Also, Mary seeks June's advice when looking for a change.

episodes.title: A Black Hole
episodes.description: The Coopers discuss the possibilities of black holes and alternate universes when Dr. Sturgis comes over for dinner,

episodes.title: The Wild and Woolly World of Nonlinear Dynamics
episodes.description: Missy's first heartbreak triggers a series of events that lead the Cooper family to the brink.

episodes.title: One Bad Night and Chaos of Selfish Desires
episodes.description: Sheldon and Missy both run away from home, and Mary gets upsetting news about George Sr.

episodes.title: Snoopin' Around and the Wonder Twins of Atheism
episodes.description: Sheldon encourages Missy to question the Bible. Also, Meemaw is determined to catch George Sr. in a lie, and Mary helps Pastor Jeff search for a youth pastor.

episodes.title: Potential Energy and Hooch on a Park Bench
episodes.description: Sheldon tries to convince Dr. Sturgis to return to the university. Also, Georgie upsets the family when he makes a life-changing decision.

episodes.title: Pish Posh and a Secret Back Room
episodes.description: Sheldon, Missy and Georgie adapt to new living arrangements. Also, Meemaw opens a gambling room.

episodes.title: Stuffed Animals and A Sweet Southern Syzygy
episodes.description: Sheldon and Dr. Linkletter struggle to solve an equation. Also, Georgie has a solution for Meemaw's business woes, and George Sr. gives advice on Missy's love life.

episodes.title: Money Laundering and a Cascade of Hormones
episodes.description: Missy asks some uncomfortable questions at church, and Meemaw and Georgie go into business together.

episodes.title: An Introduction to Engineering and a Glob of Hair Gel
episodes.description: Sheldon takes his first engineering class with Professor Boucher. Also, Meemaw and Dale help take care of his ex-wife, June.

episodes.title: The Grand Chancellor and a Den of Sin
episodes.description: Sheldon battles President Hagemeyer's mysterious boss over the university's science requirements. Also, Mary discovers that Georgie is working at Meemaw's illegal gambling room.

episodes.title: The Yips and an Oddly Hypnotic Bohemian
episodes.description: Sheldon gets the science yips and has to learn how to not think. Also, George Sr. plays handyman at Brenda Sparks' house.

episodes.title: An Expensive Glitch and a Goof-Off Room
episodes.description: Sheldon gets a dorm room all to himself. Also, Meemaw gains an unwanted business partner.

episodes.title: A Lock-In, a Weather Girl and a Disgusting Habit
episodes.description: Sheldon acts as Mary's spy during a youth lock-in at church. Also, Georgie is attracted to an older woman, Mandy.

episodes.title: A Pink Cadillac and a Glorious Tribal Dance
episodes.description: Sheldon attends his first comic book convention. Also, Mary tries selling make-up.

episodes.title: A Lot of Band-Aids and the Cooper Surrender
episodes.description: Sheldon makes friends with his dorm neighbors. Also, George Sr. learns his job is in jeopardy.

episodes.title: A Free Scratcher and Feminine Wiles
episodes.description: Sheldon butts heads with Dr. Lee, a new scientist in the lab. Also, Mary is given a lotto ticket.

episodes.title: A Lobster, an Armadillo and a Way Bigger Number
episodes.description: Sheldon joins Dr. Linkletter and Dr. Sturgis on a science road trip. Also, Georgie continues to lie about his age.

episodes.title: A Suitcase Full of Cash and a Yellow Clown Car
episodes.description: Meemaw's gambling room is a success, and Sheldon dips his toe in the stock market. Also, Missy starts a business.

episodes.title: A Solo Peanut, a Social Butterfly and the Truth
episodes.description: Sheldon gets an odd request from an old friend, Paige. Also, George Sr. and Mary are caught in the middle of Meemaw and Dale's breakup, and Georgie comes clean to Mandy.

episodes.title: Babies, Lies and a Resplendent Cannoli
episodes.description: Sheldon copes with the death of a hero. Also, Missy wants to babysit, and Georgie struggles with his big secret.

episodes.title: A God-Fearin' Baptist and a Hot Trophy Husband
episodes.description: George and Mary insist on meeting the new woman in Georgie's life. Also, Sheldon and Missy have suspicions about what's going on with their family.

episodes.title: Uncle Sheldon and a Hormonal Firecracker
episodes.description: Sheldon and Missy learn about Georgie's pregnancy, and the whole family promises to keep it a secret.

episodes.title: White Trash, Holy Rollers and Punching People
episodes.description: As the church congregation gossips about Georgie, Missy stands up for her brother, and Sheldon is distracted by the family drama.

episodes.title: A Clogged Pore, a Little Spanish and the Future
episodes.description: Sheldon struggles to cope with the first signs of puberty, Mary and George Sr. both hunt for new jobs, and Georgie and Meemaw take a business trip across the border.

episodes.title: Four Hundred Cartons of Undeclared Cigarettes and a Niblingo
episodes.description: George Sr. bails Meemaw and Georgie out of jail. Also, Sheldon and Missy meet Mandy, and Mary feels unwelcome at church.

episodes.title: Future Worf and the Margarita of the South Pacific
episodes.description: Sheldon and Missy try to help the family's finances. Also, Mary struggles to find her footing without the church.

episodes.title: Passion's Harvest and a Sheldocracy
episodes.description: Sheldon must choose sides in an ethical dilemma. Also, Mary tries her hand at writing and Mandy needs a new place to live.

episodes.title: Blonde Ambition and the Concept of Zero
episodes.description: Sheldon makes a terrifying mathematical discovery while tutoring Billy. Also, Mary is jealous of Missy's relationship with Mandy and Meemaw.

episodes.title: A Resident Advisor and the Word 'Sketchy'
episodes.description: At college, Sheldon decides to expand his responsibilities and become a dorm resident advisor. Also, Meemaw and Dale make a sketchy business deal and Mary and George Sr. rekindle their romance.

episodes.title: An Ugly Car, an Affair and Some Kickass Football
episodes.description: George Sr. is asked to help with the football team. Also, Mandy discovers Georgie and Meemaw's secret business.

episodes.title: A Tougher Nut and a Note on File
episodes.description: Sheldon's search for a comic book leads him to a breakthrough. Also, Georgie and Mandy have an uncomfortable first encounter with her parents, Jim and Audrey.

episodes.title: Legalese and a Whole Hoo-Ha
episodes.description: Sheldon's database invention puts him at odds with the university. Also, the church takes issue with Meemaw's video store.

episodes.title: College Dropouts and the Medford Miracle
episodes.description: Sheldon considers dropping out of college to focus on building his database. Also, George Sr. is frustrated when someone else gets credit for his football wins.

episodes.title: Pancake Sunday and Textbook Flirting
episodes.description: Mary struggles to make new friends while Mandy pushes Georgie to date another woman.

episodes.title: Ruthless, Toothless and a Week of Bed Rest
episodes.description: Sheldon learns the university is building a database without him. Also, Mary takes care of a bedridden Mandy and Meemaw.

episodes.title: A Baby Shower and Testosterone-Rich Banter
episodes.description: Mary butts heads with Mandy's mother, Audrey, and Sheldon attempts male bonding.

episodes.title: A Frat Party, a Sleepover and the Mother of All Blisters
episodes.description: Paige drags Sheldon to a college party and Missy gets caught in a lie.

episodes.title: A Launch Party and a Whole Human Being
episodes.description: The Coopers can't be found as Mandy goes into labor. Also, Sheldon is excited about the launch of his database.

episodes.title: Teen Angst and a Smart-Boy Walk of Shame
episodes.description: Sheldon confronts the failure of his database. Also, Georgie and Mandy struggle as new parents and Missy feels forgotten.

episodes.title: A Stolen Truck and Going on the Lam
episodes.description: Missy steals her dad's truck and hits the road with her friend Paige.

episodes.title: A German Folk Song and an Actual Adult
episodes.description: Georgie goes on a birthday date and Mary confronts Brenda about her relationship with George. Also, Sheldon takes an interest in Missy's favorite TV show.

episodes.title: Little Green Men and a Fella's Marriage Proposal
episodes.description: Sheldon wants to search for life on other planets and Mandy answers Georgie's marriage proposal. Also, Missy is caught between two friends.

episodes.title: A New Weather Girl and a Stay-at-Home Coddler
episodes.description: Mandy gets an exciting job opportunity and Sheldon worries that he's falling behind. Also, Georgie takes his daughter to work.

episodes.title: German for Beginners and a Crazy Old Man with a Bat
episodes.description: The gambling room gets broken into and Sheldon wants to study abroad. Also, Missy makes a new friend.

episodes.title: A Romantic Getaway and a Germanic Meat-Based Diet
episodes.description: Mandy surprises Georgie with a spa weekend and Sheldon prepares for his summer in Germany.

episodes.title: A Tornado, a 10-Hour Flight and a Darn Fine Ring
episodes.description: Sheldon and Mary head to Germany while the rest of the Cooper family braves a tornado that is heading straight for Medford.

episodes.title: A Weiner Schnitzel and Underwear in a Tree
episodes.description: News of the tornado reaches Sheldon and Mary in Germany. Also, with the Cooper house in chaos, Missy steps up.

episodes.title: A Roulette Wheel and a Piano Playing Dog
episodes.description: Sheldon realizes he is the weakest student in his class. Meemaw is looking to expand her gambling business.

episodes.title: A Strudel and a Hot American Boy Toy
episodes.description: Sheldon explores Germany behind Mary's back, Missy attempts to pull a fast one on George Sr. and Meemaw and Dale adjust to living together.

episodes.title: Ants on a Log and a Cheating Winker
episodes.description: Missy steps up, Mary has a surprise for George, and Sheldon finds his dorm occupied.

episodes.title: A Frankenstein's Monster and a Crazy Church Guy
episodes.description: Sheldon helps his roommate try to beat the stock market, Missy and Billy Sparks throw a party, and Mary finds a new church.

episodes.title: Baptists, Catholics and an Attempted Drowning
episodes.description: Georgie and Mandy's wedding plans pit Mary against Mandy's mom, Audrey, with baby CeeCee caught in the middle.

episodes.title: A Proper Wedding and Skeletons in the Closet
episodes.description: Georgie and Mandy get married! Meanwhile, Meemaw's gambling room gets raided.

episodes.title: An Ankle Monitor and a Big Plastic Crap House
episodes.description: Sheldon studies to be Meemaw's lawyer when she is put on house arrest, and the Coopers have a plumbing emergency.

episodes.title: A Fancy Article and a Scholarship for a Baby
episodes.description: Sheldon's published paper leads to a frenzy of grad school recruiting, and Georgie tries to speak more properly in front of his daughter.

episodes.title: Community Service and the Key to a Happy Marriage
episodes.description: Meemaw gets assigned a tough probation officer, and Georgie takes marriage advice from his father-in-law.

episodes.title: A Little Snip and Teaching Old Dogs
episodes.description: George Sr. is worried that Mary wants another baby and gets a vasectomy behind her back. Meanwhile, Drs. Linkletter and Sturgis go to Sheldon for science tutoring.

episodes.title: A New Home and a Traditional Texas Torture
episodes.description: George Sr. gets an exciting job offer, and Sheldon prepares for his move to California.

episodes.title: Funeral
episodes.description: Young Sheldon ends its seven-year run with a must-see two-episode series finale. Jim Parsons and Mayim Bialik reprise their roles as Sheldon Cooper and Amy Farrah Fowler in an unforgettable hour of television.

episodes.title: Memoir
episodes.description: Young Sheldon ends its seven-year run with a must-see two-episode series finale. Jim Parsons and Mayim Bialik reprise their roles as Sheldon Cooper and Amy Farrah Fowler in an unforgettable hour of television.

tt4574334.title: Stranger Things
tt4574334.description: When a young boy vanishes, a small town uncovers a mystery involving secret experiments, terrifying supernatural forces and one strange little girl.

episodes.title: Chapter One: The Vanishing of Will Byers
episodes.description: On his way home from a friend's house, young Will sees something terrifying. Nearby, a sinister secret lurks in the depths of a government lab.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: The Weirdo on Maple Street
episodes.description: Lucas, Mike and Dustin try to talk to the girl they found in the woods. Hopper questions an anxious Joyce about an unsettling phone call.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: Holly, Jolly
episodes.description: An increasingly concerned Nancy looks for Barb and finds out what Jonathan's been up to. Joyce is convinced Will is trying to talk to her.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: The Body
episodes.description: Refusing to believe Will is dead, Joyce tries to connect with her son. The boys give Eleven a makeover. Nancy and Jonathan form an unlikely alliance.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: The Flea and the Acrobat
episodes.description: Hopper breaks into the lab while Nancy and Jonathan confront the force that took Will. The boys ask Mr. Clarke how to travel to another dimension.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: The Monster
episodes.description: A frantic Jonathan looks for Nancy in the darkness, but Steve's looking for her, too. Hopper and Joyce uncover the truth about the lab's experiments.

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: The Bathtub
episodes.description: Eleven struggles to reach Will, while Lucas warns that "the bad men are coming." Nancy and Jonathan show the police what Jonathan caught on camera.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: The Upside Down
episodes.description: Dr. Brenner holds Hopper and Joyce for questioning while the boys wait with Eleven in the gym. Back at Will's, Nancy and Jonathan prepare for battle.

episodes.title: Chapter One: MADMAX
episodes.description: As the town preps for Halloween, a high-scoring rival shakes things up at the arcade, and a skeptical Hopper inspects a field of rotting pumpkins.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: Trick or Treat, Freak
episodes.description: After Will sees something terrible on trick-or-treat night, Mike wonders whether Eleven's still out there. Nancy wrestles with the truth about Barb.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: The Pollywog
episodes.description: Dustin adopts a strange new pet, and Eleven grows increasingly impatient. A well-meaning Bob urges Will to stand up to his fears.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: Will the Wise
episodes.description: An ailing Will opens up to Joyce -- with disturbing results. While Hopper digs for the truth, Eleven unearths a surprising discovery.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: Dig Dug
episodes.description: Nancy and Jonathan swap conspiracy theories with a new ally as Eleven searches for someone from her past. "Bob the Brain" tackles a difficult problem.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: The Spy
episodes.description: Will's connection to a shadowy evil grows stronger, but no one's quite sure how to stop it. Elsewhere, Dustin and Steve forge an unlikely bond.

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: The Lost Sister
episodes.description: Psychic visions draw Eleven to a band of violent outcasts and an angry girl with a shadowy past.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: The Mind Flayer
episodes.description: An unlikely hero steps forward when a deadly development puts the Hawkins Lab on lockdown, trapping Will and several others inside.

episodes.title: Chapter Nine: The Gate
episodes.description: Eleven makes plans to finish what she started while the survivors turn up the heat on the monstrous force that's holding Will hostage.

episodes.title: Chapter One: Suzie, Do You Copy?
episodes.description: Summer brings new jobs and budding romance. But the mood shifts when Dustin's radio picks up a Russian broadcast, and Will senses something is wrong.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: The Mall Rats
episodes.description: Nancy and Jonathan follow a lead, Steve and Robin sign on to a secret mission, and Max and Eleven go shopping. A rattled Billy has troubling visions.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: The Case of the Missing Lifeguard
episodes.description: With El and Max looking for Billy, Will declares a day without girls. Steve and Dustin go on a stakeout, and Joyce and Hopper return to Hawkins Lab.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: The Sauna Test
episodes.description: A code red brings the gang back together to face a frighteningly familiar evil. Karen urges Nancy to keep digging, and Robin finds a useful map.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: The Flayed
episodes.description: Strange surprises lurk inside an old farmhouse and deep beneath the Starcourt Mall. Meanwhile, the Mind Flayer is gathering strength.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: E Pluribus Unum
episodes.description: Dr. Alexei reveals what the Russians have been building, and Eleven sees where Billy has been. Dustin and Erica stage a daring rescue.

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: The Bite
episodes.description: With time running out -- and an assassin close behind -- Hopper's crew races back to Hawkins, where El and the kids are preparing for war.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: The Battle of Starcourt
episodes.description: Terror reigns in the food court when the Mind Flayer comes to collect. But down below, in the dark, the future of the world is at stake.

episodes.title: Chapter One: The Hellfire Club
episodes.description: El is bullied at school. Joyce opens a mysterious package. A scrappy player shakes up D&D night.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: Vecna's Curse
episodes.description: A plane brings Mike to California — and a dead body brings Hawkins to a halt. Nancy goes looking for leads. A shaken Eddie tells the gang what he saw.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: The Monster and the Superhero
episodes.description: Murray and Joyce fly to Alaska, and El faces serious consequences. Robin and Nancy dig up dirt on Hawkins' demons. Dr. Owens delivers sobering news.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: Dear Billy
episodes.description: Max is in grave danger... and running out of time. A patient at Pennhurst asylum has visitors. Elsewhere, in Russia, Hopper is hard at work.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: The Nina Project
episodes.description: Owens takes El to Nevada, where she's forced to confront her past, while the Hawkins kids comb a crumbling house for clues. Vecna claims another victim.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: The Dive
episodes.description: Behind the Iron Curtain, a risky rescue mission gets underway. The California crew seeks help from a hacker. Steve takes one for the team.

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: The Massacre at Hawkins Lab
episodes.description: As Hopper braces to battle a monster, Dustin dissects Vecna's motives — and decodes a message from beyond. El finds strength in a distant memory.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: Papa
episodes.description: Nancy has sobering visions, and El passes an important test. Back in Hawkins, the gang gathers supplies and prepares for battle.

episodes.title: Chapter Nine: The Piggyback
episodes.description: With selfless hearts and a clash of metal, heroes fight from every corner of the battlefield to save Hawkins — and the world itself.

episodes.title: Chapter One: The Crawl
episodes.description: November, 1987. The gang evades the military to scour the Upside Down for Vecna — but fails to notice a threat lurking closer to home.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: The Vanishing of Holly Wheeler
episodes.description: After a vicious attack at the Wheeler home, Mike and Nancy confront the cost of secrecy, while El and Hopper embark on a rescue mission.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: The Turnbow Trap
episodes.description: Will gains unique insight into Vecna's next move, giving the crew an opportunity to set a trap. Holly explores her new surroundings.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: Sorcerer
episodes.description: The military tightens its grip on the town. Mike, Lucas and Robin orchestrate a daring escape. El comes face-to-face with the enemy.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: Shock Jock
episodes.description: The gang hatches an electrifying plan to reconnect Will to the hive mind. Tensions flare during a search of the Upside Down's Hawkins Lab.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: Escape from Camazotz
episodes.description: As Holly and Max fight to escape Vecna's mind, El must find a way into Will's. Joyce wrestles with guilt. Jonathan and Nancy face a turning point.

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: The Bridge
episodes.description: On the anniversary of Will's disappearance, the party reunites to prepare for a battle with world-altering implications.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: The Rightside Up
episodes.description: As Vecna prepares to destroy the world as we know it, the party must put everything on the line to defeat him once and for all.

tt0460637.title: Everybody Hates Chris
tt0460637.description: Inspired by his childhood experiences, comedian Chris Rock narrates the hilarious, touching story of a teenager growing up as the eldest of children in Brooklyn, New York during the early 1980s.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates the Pilot
episodes.description: Uprooted to a new neighborhood and bussed to a predominantly white middle school two-hours away by his strict, hard-working parents, Chris struggles to find his place while keeping his siblings in line at home and dealing with the school bully, Joey.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Keisha
episodes.description: When Chris's mother, Rochelle, hires the girl next door, Keisha, to tutor Drew at Math, Chris sees this as an ideal chance to impress her. But someone else may have the same intentions. Meanwhile, Julius finds himself in an awkward position when he becomes attracted to another woman, Sheila.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Basketball
episodes.description: Chris joins the school Basketball team even though he can't play, but a failed pop quiz threatens to get him dropped. Back at home Julius gets a lodger after he offers 6 months rent up front, despite the fact he makes Rochelle nervous.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Sausage
episodes.description: Fists fly and Dr. Raymond (Jude Ciccolella) must intervene in the conflict between Chris and the school bully.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Fat Mike
episodes.description: Despite his parents' warnings, Chris lends his bike to a kid who disappears with it; While Julius is on strike, he proves to be a better housekeeper than Rochelle which makes her very angry.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Halloween
episodes.description: In order to impress a girl Chris goes to an adult party where the girl will be. With some urging from his friend he decides to go as the eccentric singer Prince.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates the Babysitter
episodes.description: When Rochelle and Julius go out for the night, they hire a sitter to look after Chris, Drew, and Tonya. But the babysitter keeps leaving the house and Chris covers for her. Julius and Rochelle's night-out is anything but romantic when the restaurant gets robbed.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates the Laundromat
episodes.description: Chris spends all day at the laundromat while watching his younger brother and sister. His parents try to get a good deal on a new TV.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Food Stamps
episodes.description: Julius finds $200 worth of food stamps but Rochelle is too embarrassed to use them; Chris and Greg have a big argument over their science project.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Greg
episodes.description: When Chris decides to hang out and play games at Greg's house without parental permission, Greg's father comes home, so Chris must hide to avoid getting caught.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Christmas
episodes.description: Rochelle and Julius don't have enough money to get Chris his new Walkman that he wants for Christmas. Drew tells Toyna the truth about Santa Claus, which makes Tonya question about other things her mom and dad told her.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates a Part-Time Job
episodes.description: After deciding to buy a leather jacket, Chris goes to work with his dad to earn money and quickly learns the value of a dollar.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Picture Day
episodes.description: Chris gets a new outfit for school picture day, but Caruso ends up stealing it. Drew hides Toyna's shoe when she breaks his toy. Rochelle sells make-up at home to make some extra money.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Valentine's Day
episodes.description: Chris gets a bunch of "I hate you" cards from Caruso and also develops a crush on a girl named Tangee on his bus ride. Tonya reveals that she has a boyfriend which surprises Julius, and Drew gets a bunch of Valentines' cards from a lot of girls.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates the Lottery
episodes.description: Julius and Rochelle struggle to give up the things they like: chocolate turtles and lottery tickets. Meanwhile, Chris claims to be a pro at "Asteroids", but when he hears that someone beat his score, it's up to him to defend his title.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates the Gout
episodes.description: Chris gets an "F" on his report card and tries to figure out a way to change his grade before his parents find out. When Julius is sick with the gout, he starts watching The Young and the Restless.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Funerals
episodes.description: When Rochelle's dad, Gene unexpectedly dies during a family dinner, Rochelle starts acting less than normal and Chris is shocked to see his mother not acting like herself.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Corleone
episodes.description: Sick of the constant bullying from Caruso, Chris attempts to get kicked out of Corleone. Meanwhile, Julius' smelly new job may drive the family away.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Drew
episodes.description: Fed up with Drew being the best at everything, Chris decides to take up karate. But when the two brothers challenge each other, Chris ends up breaking Drew's hand. Meanwhile, Toyna gets a lesson in gossip at the beauty salon.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Playboy
episodes.description: Chris finds a Playboy magazine in Julius' toolbox and takes it to school, but the assistant principal confiscates it, Chris attempts to get it back. Julius is surprised when he finds out that Rochelle has money stashed in their room. Toyna teases Drew because of his fear of spiders.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Jail
episodes.description: Chris has to sell cookies in order to go on a field trip to Washington D.C. Meanwhile Julius and Rochelle had tickets for Dreamgirls but Drew and Tonya get sick.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Father's Day
episodes.description: Chris tries to find a gift for Julius for Father's Day, but all Julius wants is a day to himself.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Rejection
episodes.description: Chris asks a girl on a date, but gets stood up; Rochelle clashes with new neighbor Louise over the establishment of a neighborhood watch program.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates the Class President
episodes.description: Chris runs for 8th grade class president, and Julius is diagnosed with high blood pressure.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Elections
episodes.description: Chris has to prepare a speech as part of his campaign for class president; Mr. Omar the funeral director moves into the rental apartment but winds up increasing Julius's stress.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates a Liar
episodes.description: Chris leads the neighborhood into thinking that he and Tasha are a couple. Drew feels left out when Rochelle doesn't have enough time for him. Julius is obsessed with trading stamps.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Malvo
episodes.description: When Chris is robbed at work by the neighborhood's well-known criminal Malvo, he is scared to tell Doc who robbed the place. Julius gets a Betamax and is upset when Tonya accidentally tapes over Julius' stories.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates the Buddy System
episodes.description: The new vice-principal pairs Chris and Caruso up as buddies on a school field trip, but Chris and Caruso end up being left behind. Toyna takes Rochelle's hoop earrings and then loses one of them. Julius searches for a Wayne Gretzky hockey jersey for Drew.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Promises
episodes.description: Chris finds out that he can't fulfill his campaign promises as class president, causing him to become increasingly unpopular at school; Rochelle's brother comes to stay with the family temporarily but shows little interest in finding a job or moving out.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Thanksgiving
episodes.description: Julius' successful younger brother joins Chris' family for Thanksgiving dinner and Julius works hard to prepare the perfect Thanksgiving meal.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Superstition
episodes.description: Chris's luck changes after he borrows a pair of socks from his father; Drew and Tonya conspire to get their parents to buy them things.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Kris
episodes.description: Julius works at a department store dressed up as Santa Claus along with Chris dressed up as an elf, but Julius gets fired for freaking the kids out and Chris ends up in the hospital.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Eggs
episodes.description: For a class project, Chris has to take care of an egg as if it were a baby; Julius looks for ways to save money on the electric bill.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Hall Monitors
episodes.description: Chris' classmates do not take him seriously when he signs up to be a hall monitor; Tonya discovers that her friends hang out with her to get closer to Drew.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Snow Day
episodes.description: On a snowy day, Chris arrives at school only to find that classes have been canceled and he is expected to spend the day with Principal Edwards, the only other person there.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates the Substitute
episodes.description: A black substitute teacher takes over Chris' class while Ms. Morello is away, but the teacher ends up giving Chris a hard time, prompting Chris to figure out a way to get rid of him. Toyna discovers that she can her own way by accusing Drew of hitting her, and Mr. Omar gets on Julius' last nerve.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Cutting School
episodes.description: With their teacher Ms. Morello out for the day, Chris and Greg decide to cut school and go see the movie "Ghostbusters".

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Chain Snatching
episodes.description: When Chris stops Malvo trying to steal a gold chain from Vanessa, Malvo demands that Chris get him a gold chain. Tonya tries to win tickets to a Billy Ocean concert. Rochelle discovers that Julius has been hiding a credit card from her.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates DJs
episodes.description: Chris decides to become a DJ, but his new career takes a wrong turn when he accidentally scratches Rochelle's James Brown album. Drew asks Julius to take him to a magic show, but Julius is afraid of rabbits.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Baseball
episodes.description: Chris is stuck between a rock and a hard place when he has to make a decision about going to a baseball game with Julius and Drew or go to the movies with Tasha. Rochelle forgets to mail Tonya's letter to the Billy Ocean fan club. Rochelle's brother, Michael asks Vanessa out on a date.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Gambling
episodes.description: Chris becomes Bed-Stuy's favorite odds-maker after Doc discovers he has a natural talent for predicting a game's outcome.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Dirty Jokes
episodes.description: Chris starts telling dirty jokes after listening to his parents' comedy records. Rochelle tries to find a man for her mother, Maxine. Drew avoids a girl in a neighborhood who likes him.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Math
episodes.description: Chris needs to get a good grade in algebra so the class will get a pizza party. Meanwhile, Drew breaks his dad's fav chair.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates the Last Day
episodes.description: Chris is trying to get back at the school bully. Meanwhile, Drew wants to wear his graduation grown and cap, but something happens to it.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates the Guidance Counselor
episodes.description: At the end of the 8th grade, Mrs. Morello hands out the Grade Eight Proficiency Assessment Test (GEPA) and Chris doesn't study so he thinks it doesn't count. So, he purposely does bad on the test, which makes him See Mr. Avich, the guidance counselor, who tries to get Chris into a special needs class.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Caruso
episodes.description: Caruso is beat up by one of Chris's classmates. As a result, the absence of Caruso's power throws the entire school into chaos.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Driving
episodes.description: Julius allows Chris to park the family car across the street, but he takes the car to school instead. Meanwhile, Rochelle goes to court to dispute a speeding ticket.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Blackie
episodes.description: Chris is allowed to get a dog after the house is robbed. The dog turns out to be impossible to train, until Chris discovers that the dog only understands Spanish.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates the Bachelor Pad
episodes.description: Since the rest of the family is sick, Chris is forced to spend a few nights at Mr. Omar's apartment, where he discovers Richard Pryor for the first time.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Bed-Stuy
episodes.description: After Chris's first article for the school paper is rejected, he creates a bogus story about a serial killer in Bed-Stuy--which only gets him in more trouble.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Houseguests
episodes.description: Greg's friendship with Chris is put to the test when he spends the week at Chris's house, and Julius has an eventful first week as a taxicab driver.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Minimum Wage
episodes.description: When Doc refuses to give Chris a raise, Chris goes out and gets a new job at the local Chinese restaurant.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates the New Kid
episodes.description: When a second black kid enrolls in Chris's school, the two become fast friends, which makes Greg jealous. Julius becomes nervous when the IRS gives the family a larger-than-expected tax refund.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Kwanzaa
episodes.description: Julius talks the family into celebrating Kwanza instead of Christmas this year because Kwanza is cheaper. Meanwhile, Chris helps Kill Moves find his mother as part of his school Christmas assignment.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates the Port Authority
episodes.description: The family plans to go to a relative's funeral in South Carolina, but Chris and Julius lose the ticket money to a three-card monte dealer.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Bad Boys
episodes.description: Chris models himself after a popular rapper and takes on a bad boy persona in order to impress Tasha. Julius gets the family a free dinner at an expensive restaurant, but the restaurant is less than hospitable.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates the First Kiss
episodes.description: Chris tries to get himself invited to a spin-the-bottle party so that he can get a chance to kiss Tasha. He winds up kissing another girl, which only causes unforeseen problems.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Easter
episodes.description: Chris plans to take Tasha to an Easter pageant after she breaks up with her boyfriend; Rochelle seeks to win the hat competition at church.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Gretzky
episodes.description: Chris accompanies Drew as they skip school to get Wayne Gretzky's autograph for Drew.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates the BFD
episodes.description: Chris accepts a $250 Black Funeral Directors scholarship from Mr. Omar so that he can pay for Run-DMC concert tickets, but he gets more than he bargained for.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Ex-Cons
episodes.description: Malvo is out of prison. But instead of coming after Chris, he asks for his help in getting him into high school. Julius and Drew put a wager on a Mets/Dodgers series, and Tanya's new friend uses her as an alibi to lie to her mom.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Earth Day
episodes.description: Chris tries to enlist Julius to help him collect cans for an Earth Day project. Meanwhile, Tonya is reprimanded at school while mimicking her mother, causing Rochelle to try and stop yelling anymore.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Being Cool
episodes.description: Chris and Greg try to become cool, and Chris gets suspended from school when Greg is busted with a cigarette and blames it on Chris. And that's where the real trouble begins for him.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates the Ninth-Grade Dance
episodes.description: Chris catches a lot of grief for asking a white girl from his class to the ninth grade dance, so he backs out of it, which only makes things worse. Julius and Drew help out a relative starting a business, and Tanya takes up ballet.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Mother's Day
episodes.description: Chris buys a knock-off version of an expensive perfume from Risky as a Mother's Day present, and Rochelle gets a rash from it. Julius discovers that he talked Drew into giving away an old toy that is worth $150.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Graduation
episodes.description: Chris tries to get accepted into the Bronx Science Academy so that he can go to high school with Greg, Julius helps his brother start a Mix Tape business not knowing that they're illegal, and Drew helps Tanya with her ballet recital.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Tattaglia
episodes.description: Chris is relieved to find out that he is not the only black person at his new high school. However, he does run into problems because he is the only non-white student in his homeroom class, and the teacher can't stand him.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Cake
episodes.description: An androgynous boy in Chris' home ec class helps him meet a cute classmate. Rochelle learns that Tasha's mom is an ex-con. Drew and Tonya get a job babysitting Mr. Omar's fish.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Homecoming
episodes.description: Chris gets a cute girl to go to the homecoming dance with him, and discovers that her parents are the Huxtables. But he may be forced to ditch her when he finds out that Greg is down and needs his attention.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates the English Teacher
episodes.description: Chris talks the English teacher to show movies based on books instead of reading the actual books, but their friendship is short-lived. Julius' plan to raise Mr. Omar's rent backfires when his apartment fails inspection.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates My Man
episodes.description: Chris gets in over his head when he helps a star football player with his studies. Julius suddenly has a new outlook on life when he takes a job helping Mr. Omar at the funeral home.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Doc's
episodes.description: Chris can't stand working for Doc's new young girlfriend at the store, so he deliberately breaks them up. Meanwhile, Tanya starts wearing a stuffed bra to school.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Snitches
episodes.description: Chris' plan to snitch on a shooter and collect the reward money backfires when Jerome is put in jail. Meanwhile, Julius sets up the perfect anniversary for Rochelle, only to see it accidentally fall apart.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Big Bird
episodes.description: Chris starts dating one of the nerdiest girls in the school, but doesn't want anyone to know about it. Meanwhile, the entire neighborhood bets on whether the Giants or the Jets will lose first.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates James
episodes.description: Ms. Morello forces Chris to become a "big brother," the family gets an answering machine, and Julius tries to get marital advice from a new talk show called "Oprah".

episodes.title: Everybody Hates New Year's Eve
episodes.description: While Chris tries to find a way to get to Times Square for New Year's Eve, Julius becomes a hero after he talks a jumper down from the George Washington Bridge.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Mr. Levine
episodes.description: Chris becomes friends with Mr. Levine, Rochelle finds out she's a year younger, and Greg tries to stop being called Chris and Greg.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Varsity Jackets
episodes.description: Chris joins the wrestling team to get a varsity letter, Rochelle puts the entire family on a diet, and Drew tries to put together a girl group.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Fake IDs
episodes.description: Chris and Greg try to get fake IDs so that they can go to a Fat Boys concert, Drew buys a pair of X-ray glasses, and Rochelle gets upset when Julius won't let her give him a surprise birthday party.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates PSATs
episodes.description: Rochelle wants Chris to do well on the PSATs so that she can show him off to an elite African American club she wants the family to join. As a result, he cheats and gets a perfect score.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Boxing
episodes.description: Mr. Thurman convinces Chris to take up boxing, a new neighbor has the hots for Julius, and Rochelle gets lonely for Julius while he takes on extra shifts.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Lasagna
episodes.description: Chris is forced to hide some marijuana for a neighborhood punk on the run from the police. Out of fear, he decides to bake it in his lasagna for his cooking class.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Spring Break
episodes.description: Greg breaks his leg after he is hit by a car, but Chris doesn't want anyone to know that he was driving the car. Meanwhile, Julius tries to take Tanya and Drew to Amityville for a beach vacation during Spring Break.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates the Car
episodes.description: Chris buys his first car, which only leads to a series of unforeseen problems. Meanwhile, everybody else in the house accidentally stumbles into everyone else's private business.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Back Talk
episodes.description: Chris comes to blows with Rochelle when he refuses to clean the dishes, and Mr. Omar gives his notice to vacate because he believes he is dying.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Tasha
episodes.description: Chris runs into unexpected problems when Tasha becomes his girlfriend, Rochelle finds out that Julius is still technically married to another woman, and Drew and Tonya have a contest to see who can be quiet the longest.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates Bomb Threats
episodes.description: Chris calls in a bomb threat to get out of doing a punishwork assignment, and Rochelle tries to get rid of a "mojo" placed on her by one of her customers at the salon.

episodes.title: Everybody Hates the G.E.D.
episodes.description: Chris opts to take the G.E.D. over repeating the 10th grade, Drew tries to go on Amateur Night at the Apollo, Julius tries to get $25 back from somebody who owes him, and Tanya graduates from sixth grade.

tt1196946.title: The Mentalist
tt1196946.description: Patrick Jane, an independent consultant with the California Bureau of Investigation (CBI), has a remarkable track record for solving serious crimes by using his razor sharp skills of observation. Within the Bureau, Jane is notorious for his blatant lack of protocol and his semi-celebrity past as a psychic medium, whose paranormal abilities he now admits he feigned. No-nonsense Senior Agent Teresa Lisbon openly resists having Jane in her unit and alternates between reluctantly acknowledging Jane's usefulness and blasting him for his theatrics, narcissism, and dangerous lack of boundaries. Lisbon's team includes agents Kimball Cho, Wayne Rigsby and rookie member Grace Van Pelt, who all think Jane's a loose cannon but admire his charm and knack for clearing cases.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: Consultant Patrick Jane, Senior Agent Teresa Lisbon and her team investigate the double murder in Palm Springs of a pro golfer's wife and her doctor, which has the hallmarks of a serial killer with a personal connection to Jane.

episodes.title: Red Hair and Silver Tape
episodes.description: While Lisbon and her team investigate the murder of a young waitress in the Napa Valley, Jane goes behind Lisbon's back to orchestrate his own undercover operation using Van Pelt as bait.

episodes.title: Red Tide
episodes.description: When a high school girl's body washes up on the beach, Patrick Jane sets a mentalist trap in order to get her surfing friends to turn on each other and reveal what really happened.

episodes.title: Ladies in Red
episodes.description: When the team learns that a wealthy investment banker found murdered inside his locked safe room was living a dual life and skimming millions from clients, Patrick Jane sets up a mental conundrum to see which of the suspects will show their true colors.

episodes.title: Redwood
episodes.description: When a girl is found covered in blood and holding the murder weapon that killed her best friend, she becomes an obvious suspect, though she can't remember anything. But Jane, believing she's innocent, engineers a risky maneuver in which she must relive the terrifying events in order to spark her memory.

episodes.title: Red Handed
episodes.description: While investigating the case of a murdered casino owner, Patrick Jane uses his mentalist skills to ultimately entrap the killer, and win big at the card tables.

episodes.title: Seeing Red
episodes.description: Intent on proving a so-called psychic is a fraud - as well as a killer - Patrick arranges a séance to expose the murderer.

episodes.title: The Thin Red Line
episodes.description: While the police suspect a drug dealer on trial is behind the murders of the State's witness in his case, as well as his girlfriend, Patrick Jane sees a different motive for the crime, as well as a different suspect.

episodes.title: Flame Red
episodes.description: When the CBI uncovers three arson cases, Patrick Jane suspects the only surviving member of a National Guard unit of murdering his friends, and goes undercover to prove it.

episodes.title: Red Brick and Ivy
episodes.description: When a leading scientific researcher is killed by poisoning, Patrick Jane takes a personal interest in the case when he learns the prime suspect is the victim's wife, and Jane's former psychiatrist.

episodes.title: Red John's Friends
episodes.description: Patrick Jane, enticed by the promise from a convicted murderer that he'll reveal information about Red John upon his release, becomes singularly focused and quits the CBI in order to prove the prisoner is innocent.

episodes.title: Red Rum
episodes.description: When a young football talent from a small town appears to have been killed in a black magic sacrifice ritual, the CBI investigation focuses on a self-proclaimed Wiccan witch, whose cat was allegedly tortured and killed by the victim prior to his death.

episodes.title: Paint It Red
episodes.description: While it appears obvious that a business tycoon's son-in-law was in on the robbery of a $50 million painting since his body is found where the painting once hung, Patrick Jane suspects others, including a Russian oil baron, an art forger, and an art curator of being involved.

episodes.title: Crimson Casanova
episodes.description: With Patrick Jane's help, Cho goes undercover as a ladies' man with all the right moves in order to catch a killer who has his own set of pseudo-mentalist techniques.

episodes.title: Scarlett Fever
episodes.description: As Jane and the team investigate the poisoning death of the "queen bee" in a country club, they discover that the community is full of secrets, including love affairs and drug abuse.

episodes.title: Bloodshot
episodes.description: Patrick Jane must rely on his other senses during the murder investigation of a financial advisor when he loses his sight as a result of an explosion.

episodes.title: Carnelian Inc.
episodes.description: A story of greed and betrayal pits Patrick Jane against a group of financiers when the CBI investigates a series of murders at a corporate retreat in the wilds of the Sierra Nevada foothills.

episodes.title: Russet Potatoes
episodes.description: Patrick Jane and the CBI team track down a mastermind who hypnotizes people into doing their bidding.

episodes.title: A Dozen Red Roses
episodes.description: Patrick Jane and the team go to Hollywood when they investigate the murder of a movie producer.

episodes.title: Red Sauce
episodes.description: Patrick Jane and the team investigate the murder of a mobster who was in witness protection.

episodes.title: Miss Red
episodes.description: Patrick Jane uses his mentalist skills to play suspects off each other in order to solve the case of a wealthy software company CEO found murdered on his yacht.

episodes.title: Blood Brothers
episodes.description: Patrick Jane must find a clever way to convince the troubled kids at a wilderness program to confide in him about what really happened surrounding the death of one of their peers.

episodes.title: Red John's Footsteps
episodes.description: Lisbon fears that serial killer Red John is drawing Patrick Jane into a trap when the CBI team investigates the murder of a young girl and the abduction of her twin sister.

episodes.title: Redemption
episodes.description: While the unit tackles a murder case involving a woman who stole a million dollars from her employer, Jane and Lisbon learn that the Red John case has been reassigned to a new CBI team led by the straight-shooting agent Sam Bosco.

episodes.title: The Scarlet Letter
episodes.description: Lisbon and the team work the case of a State Senator's murdered intern, while Jane simultaneously tries to find out what new information Bosco has uncovered on the Red John case.

episodes.title: Red Badge
episodes.description: Jane, Cho, Rigsby, and Van Pelt decide to conduct their own investigation when Lisbon is accused of murdering a child molester she arrested who was recently paroled.

episodes.title: Red Menace
episodes.description: Jane, Lisbon and the CBI team encounter one of California's most dangerous motorcycle gangs when investigating the death of their primary attorney.

episodes.title: Red Scare
episodes.description: The CBI team investigates the death of a wealthy man living in a haunted mansion, and Rigsby and Van Pelt grow closer.

episodes.title: Black Gold and Red Blood
episodes.description: Even after Bosco arrests Jane and puts him in prison for spying on the Red John investigation, Jane is able to help the CBI team from his cell to solve the murder of a young man.

episodes.title: Red Bulls
episodes.description: Minelli orders Jane, Lisbon and the rest of the unit to play nice and work together with Bosco and his team to locate a kidnapped woman being held for ransom.

episodes.title: His Red Right Hand
episodes.description: The CBI team are faced with a violent and shocking crime in their own offices, but must work the case in spite of their alarm at who may be behind it.

episodes.title: A Price Above Rubies
episodes.description: Patrick Jane and the team are called to investigate the robbery and murder of a wealthy jeweler while attending a black tie fundraiser for the CBI.

episodes.title: Throwing Fire
episodes.description: While Jane and the team examine the crime scene where a baseball scout is found murdered, Jane is clocked in the head by a ball and flashes back to his childhood with his overbearing father.

episodes.title: Rose-Colored Glasses
episodes.description: Rigsby goes undercover as an alum at a 15th high school reunion when Patrick Jane and the team investigate a double homicide that may be linked to an old prank.

episodes.title: Bleeding Heart
episodes.description: While investigating the death of a mayor's media liaison, Jane is kidnapped by an eco-terrorist who is a suspect in the case. Meanwhile, the team reluctantly agrees to be filmed for a documentary.

episodes.title: Redline
episodes.description: Patrick Jane and the CBI team investigate when the body of a high-end luxury car sales woman is found in the trunk of a Bentley in the dealership's showroom.

episodes.title: Blood In, Blood Out
episodes.description: When a member of Cho's former gang, the Avon Park Playboys, is found murdered, Patrick Jane insists on helping Cho with his off-the-books investigation.

episodes.title: Red Herring
episodes.description: Jane and the team investigate the murder of an arrogant chef during a cooking competition in Napa Valley.

episodes.title: Code Red
episodes.description: When Dr. Alicia Seberg, a government research scientist, is exposed to a deadly toxin while at work and has only hours to live, she calls Patrick Jane and the CBI to find her murderer.

episodes.title: The Red Box
episodes.description: While investogating the murder of an English tutor who stole a valuable artifact from a British museum, Patrick Jane, Lisbon, and the CBI team brace themselves to finally meet their new boss, Madeleine Hightower.

episodes.title: Aingavite Baa
episodes.description: When a Jane Doe with amnesia and covered in blood steps in front of Cho and Van Pelt's car, Patrick Jane must use all of his skills to discover who she is, her last location, and why she lost her memory.

episodes.title: Blood Money
episodes.description: When Patrick Jane's sneaky conduct causes the case of a confessed hitman to be tossed out of court, his annoyed CBI team must start the investigation over from scratch.

episodes.title: Red All Over
episodes.description: When a media mogul is murdered, Patrick Jane and the CBI team investigate cult leader Bret Stiles, who may have had an axe to grind following the publication of a critical story about his group.
Patrick Jane and the CBI team investigate the death of a mathematical genius by a gun-wielding clown.

episodes.title: Red Letter
episodes.description: Romantic sparks begin to fly when Patrick Jane and supposed psychic Kristina Frye cross paths again during the CBI investigation into the murder of a charismatic head of a non-profit organization that fights human trafficking.

episodes.title: Red Sky in the Morning
episodes.description: Patrick Jane and Kristina's first date is interrupted by a report of Red John striking again, which is discovered to be a copycat. But when Kristina reaches out to the real Red John, both she and Jane find themselves in grave danger.

episodes.title: Red Sky at Night
episodes.description: When the CBI investigates the kidnapping of a prominent lawyer and state house lobbyist, the CBI Director wants Jane on the case, but he is uncertain of his future with the unit after his encounter with Red John.

episodes.title: Cackle-Bladder Blood
episodes.description: When Jane's brother-in-law returns to town and gets mixed up in a murder investigation, Jane must come to his aid despite personal reservations.

episodes.title: The Blood on His Hands
episodes.description: When Patrick Jane faces off once again with cult leader Bret Stiles, Stiles offers Jane information regarding Red John and the missing Kristina Frye.

episodes.title: Red Carpet Treatment
episodes.description: Patrick Jane and the CBI team are called in to investigate the murder of a convict who served nine years for rape and murder, but was recently released on DNA evidence.

episodes.title: The Red Ponies
episodes.description: Patrick Jane and the CBI team hit the horse track when a jockey is found murdered and suspects abound.

episodes.title: Pink Chanel Suit
episodes.description: The case of a murder and missing person on an intensely secure wealthy family's compound perplexes Jane and the CBI team.

episodes.title: Red Hot
episodes.description: Jane and the CBI team narrowly escape a fiery end when a building explodes while they're investigating a death threat. Meanwhile, sparks fly between Lisbon and billionaire Walter Mashburn when they meet again while on the case.

episodes.title: Ball of Fire
episodes.description: Patrick Jane is kidnapped and Lisbon and the team go back through years of Jane's casework to find suspects only to realize that almost everyone he's ever dealt with might want to harm him.

episodes.title: Red Moon
episodes.description: Patrick Jane accepts the help of a local astrologer/clairvoyant, Ellis Mars, to solve the puzzling case of a triple homicide that involves two policemen and the fiancé of an EMT worker.

episodes.title: Jolly Red Elf
episodes.description: The CBI pursues two lines of investigation when a Santa is murdered: Patrick Jane goes undercover in an AA group; and Rigsby and Van Pelt question members of an authentic Santa society. Meanwhile, following the demise of a person in custody at the CBI, J.J. LaRoche is brought in to question the team when it appears to be an inside job.

episodes.title: Bloodsport
episodes.description: Patrick and the team investigate the murder of a woman with ties to mixed martial arts fighters. Meanwhile, LaRoche focuses his investigation on Rigsby, who in turn is forced to ask Cho for a huge favor in order to keep his job.

episodes.title: Bloodhounds
episodes.description: When Patrick Jane and the CBI must work with a criminal profiler, Dr. Montague, to solve a double murder, it becomes a competition for Jane to prove that his methods are superior.

episodes.title: Red Alert
episodes.description: When Patrick Jane and others are taken hostage by an armed man accused of murder, Jane must think quickly to defuse the situation.

episodes.title: Blood for Blood
episodes.description: Van Pelt's actions are called into question when a witness is murdered while she is assigned to his protection.

episodes.title: Red Gold
episodes.description: When a modern-day prospector is found dead near a mining site and Lisbon is injured during the initial stages of the investigation, Agent Hightower joins Patrick Jane in the field for the first time.

episodes.title: Red Queen
episodes.description: Evidence in the murder of an antiques dealer found dead in a museum indicates that the suspect may be a member of the CBI team.

episodes.title: Bloodstream
episodes.description: After a doctor is found dead at a golf course, the CBI team searches for a killer amongst a hospital's staff and patients. Meanwhile, when LaRoche is placed in charge of the CBI, his first act of business is to demote Lisbon, and name Cho the new team leader.

episodes.title: The Red Mile
episodes.description: Patrick Jane and the CBI team must track down the killer of a man who believed he experienced an alien abduction - even after the victim's body is stolen from the coroner's van. Meanwhile, Van Pelt takes a break from the case to shop for wedding dresses.

episodes.title: Every Rose Has Its Thorn
episodes.description: Patrick Jane sets out to prove a beautiful yet manipulative matchmaker shot and killed her husband after his body is found floating in the marina.

episodes.title: Redacted
episodes.description: Patrick Jane must deal with two failed robbery attempts: one resulting in the murder of a repair shop owner and the other involving a former suspect personally hired by Jane to break into LaRoche's home.

episodes.title: Like a Redheaded Stepchild
episodes.description: When a prison guard is stabbed to death outside of a jewelry store, Patrick Jane suspects one of the guard's inmates is the killer. Meanwhile, Rigsby questions his own father about the murder.

episodes.title: Rhapsody in Red
episodes.description: After a young violinist is shot to death, Patrick Jane questions the members of the Northern California Symphony Orchestra about the murder. Meanwhile, Cho crosses paths with a precocious young pickpocket.

episodes.title: Strawberries and Cream, Part I
episodes.description: Jane and the team investigate an explosion at a gas station, involving a thief with a bomb strapped to his chest. However, not everything is quite as it first appears when Jane reveals that the bomber was in fact the victim, and not the real killer.

episodes.title: Strawberries and Cream, Part II
episodes.description: Red John's mole is finally revealed and Patrick Jane comes face-to-face with the serial killer in an explosive confrontation that leads to shocking repercussions.

episodes.title: Scarlet Ribbons
episodes.description: In prison for killing his nemesis, Patrick Jane must prove that the man he shot really was Red John. Meanwhile, Lisbon urges Van Pelt to seek counseling in the aftermath of the death of her fiancé, Craig O'Laughlin.

episodes.title: Little Red Book
episodes.description: With Lisbon suspended and the rest of the team reassigned, Jane is reinstated as a CBI consultant and forced to work with a new team. During the investigation, Jane conspires to bring his former team back together.

episodes.title: Pretty Red Balloon
episodes.description: When the son of a former client from Jane's days as a psychic is kidnapped, Jane and the CBI team are asked to help find him. Meanwhile, Jane butts heads with his former client's new "spiritual advisor".

episodes.title: Ring Around the Rosie
episodes.description: Jane notices a suspicious looking man carrying a gun at a political rally and sets out to prove he's a psychopath on the brink of committing murder. Meanwhile, Lisbon investigates the death of a photographer at the same rally.

episodes.title: Blood and Sand
episodes.description: Jane and the CBI team investigate the murder of a woman whose body washed up on an island off the coast of California. Meanwhile, Rigsby worries that his relationship with a public defender may create awkwardness between him and Van Pelt.

episodes.title: Where in the World is Carmine O'Brien?
episodes.description: When the CBI team travels to a resort town to find out who murdered a police chief, Lisbon crosses paths with her brother Tommy, now a bounty hunter, who's tracking a bail jumper.

episodes.title: Blinking Red Light
episodes.description: The search for a serial killer hits close to home for Jane when he encounters a blogger who has devoted his life to finding the killer.

episodes.title: Pink Tops
episodes.description: In order to find the killer of an undercover narcotics cop, Jane and the CBI team retrace her investigation.

episodes.title: The Redshirt
episodes.description: Jane and the CBI investigate when a retired NFL star quarterback is presumed dead after his car blows up. Meanwhile, while preparing for a court case, Rigsby and Sarah Harrigan take their relationship to the next level.

episodes.title: Fugue in Red
episodes.description: During the search for a firefighter's killer, Jane is attacked and nearly drowned, resulting in a temporary loss of his memory and a return to his pre-CBI con man persona.

episodes.title: Always Bet on Red
episodes.description: Jane and the CBI must narrow down the long list of suspects after a high-end divorce attorney with many enemies is killed on his speed boat. Meanwhile, Jane is questioned about whether Red John was responsible for Panzer's murder.

episodes.title: My Bloody Valentine
episodes.description: With very little evidence, Jane and the CBI investigate the death of a mob boss' son. Meanwhile, while taking a belligerent witness in for questioning, Van Pelt is haunted by the memories of O'Laughlin's shooting.

episodes.title: Red Is the New Black
episodes.description: Jane and the CBI narrow down the list of suspects after a disgraced clothing designer on the verge of a comeback becomes a fashion victim. Meanwhile, FBI Agent Darcy continues her investigation into finding Red John.

episodes.title: At First Blush
episodes.description: While a jury deliberates the guilt or innocence of a defendant on trial for murder, Jane tries to prove she has been wrongfully accused before time runs out. Meanwhile, Summer may have gone too far when she helps Cho make a case against a suspect.

episodes.title: War of the Roses
episodes.description: When a charity worker is killed, Jane has Erica Flynn, a murderer he helped imprison, furloughed in exchange for information she claims to have about the case. Meanwhile, Rigsby and Sarah try to adjust to impending parenthood.

episodes.title: His Thoughts Were Red Thoughts
episodes.description: Jane is reunited with his former nemesis, cult leader Bret Stiles, when the head of an anti-cult activist organization is murdered.

episodes.title: Cheap Burgundy
episodes.description: Jane suspects that Susan Darcy has ulterior motives when she asks for his help with a homicide investigation. Meanwhile, the CBI team handles the murder of a young woman who was killed after meeting someone in an online chat room.

episodes.title: Ruddy Cheeks
episodes.description: Jane and the CBI try to narrow down the list of suspects when a terminally ill man, is found murdered. Meanwhile, Cho is forced to face his demons.

episodes.title: Pink Champagne on Ice
episodes.description: While investigating the murder of a casino employee, Jane runs into a stage magician he used to tour with during his time as a mentalist and discovers he is hiding a shocking secret.

episodes.title: Something's Rotten in Redmund
episodes.description: Jane and the CBI try to determine who would have reason to kill a popular English teacher, giving Jane an opportunity to show off his acting skills to a drama class. Meanwhile, Cho hides his relationship with Summer from Lisbon, and Rigsby gets a special delivery.

episodes.title: Ruby Slippers
episodes.description: Jane and the CBI gang get involved in the world of a Drag Queen Cabaret when a body is found burned to death in the alley behind their theater.

episodes.title: So Long, and Thanks for All the Red Snapper
episodes.description: While investigating the murder of a surfer, Lisbon reconnects with her former fiancé, Greg Tayback, who she hasn't seen in over a decade. Also, Cho questions his decision to be in a relationship with Summer.

episodes.title: Red Rover, Red Rover
episodes.description: On the eighth anniversary of his wife and daughter's death, Jane receives a message from Red John, causing Jane to lose focus on his current case and put the investigation and his career at the CBI in jeopardy.

episodes.title: The Crimson Hat
episodes.description: After another attempt to find Red John fails, Patrick Jane hits rock bottom at a Las Vegas club in the fourth season finale.

episodes.title: The Crimson Ticket
episodes.description: While Jane tries to decipher Lorelei's connection to Red John, the CBI team is forced to partner with the FBI to solve the murder of a hotel employee.

episodes.title: Devil's Cherry
episodes.description: While the team investigates the murder of a diamond cutter, Jane meets a girl who claims to be his late daughter, Charlotte.

episodes.title: Not One Red Cent
episodes.description: A bank employee is murdered during a heist and Jane and the team must work to track down the killer. Meanwhile, Lisbon is pulled deeper into the CBI/FBI rivalry.

episodes.title: Blood Feud
episodes.description: When Rigsby's father is found injured at a crime scene, the team must find out if it is the result of a long-standing small-town gang war.

episodes.title: Red Dawn
episodes.description: Flashing back several years, a distraught Patrick Jane arrives at the CBI to ask for evidence in the Red John investigation. However, while shadowing Libson, Jane winds up helping the team solve the murder of a judge's son.

episodes.title: Cherry Picked
episodes.description: The team investigates the kidnapping of a couple that may be the victim of mistaken identity, while Jane continues his investigation into Lorelei's whereabouts.

episodes.title: If It Bleeds, It Leads
episodes.description: The team investigates the murder of a reporter who may have become too close to her story, while Jane insists on pursuing his own leads to find Lorelei.

episodes.title: Red Sails in the Sunset
episodes.description: With the help of Bret Stiles, Jane orchestrates an elaborate plan to break Lorelei Martins out of prison in the hope that she will lead him to Red John.

episodes.title: Black Cherry
episodes.description: The CBI team investigates the murder of a real estate agent with former gang ties, while Jane searches for leads on his new connection to Red John.

episodes.title: Panama Red
episodes.description: The death of a young botanist leads the team into the lucrative world of medical marijuana, while Cho's work with the rapid response team brings him back into contact with Summer.

episodes.title: Days of Wine and Roses
